+"""PC side of amazinghand-hil/1. PL telemetry alone controls the MuJoCo plant.
+
+There is deliberately no software-FSM fallback when the board is unavailable.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+import socket
+
+from app.control import scs_protocol as sp
+from app.control.mujoco_plant import MujocoPlant
+
+PROTOCOL = "amazinghand-hil/1"
+STATES = ("IDLE", "PREGRASP", "CLOSING", "HOLD", "RELEASING", "PROTECT")
+
+
+def validate_reply(reply, seq=None):
+    if not isinstance(reply, dict) or reply.get("protocol") != PROTOCOL or reply.get("source") != "pl":
+        raise ValueError("matching PL protocol/source required; no simulator fallback")
+    for field in ("seq", "accepted_seq", "feedback_seq", "fault", "pl_tick",
+                  "command_count", "feedback_count"):
+        if type(reply.get(field)) is not int or not 0 <= reply[field] <= 0xFFFFFFFF:
+            raise ValueError(f"invalid PL {field}")
+    if seq is not None and any(reply[field] != seq for field in ("seq", "accepted_seq", "feedback_seq")):
+        raise ValueError("PL sequence/feedback acknowledgement mismatch")
+    if reply.get("state") not in STATES or type(reply.get("torque_enabled")) is not bool:
+        raise ValueError("invalid PL state or torque flag")
+    if (reply["fault"] or reply["state"] == "PROTECT") and reply["torque_enabled"]:
+        raise ValueError("unsafe PL telemetry: torque enabled during fault")
+    targets = reply.get("target_raw")
+    if not isinstance(targets, list) or len(targets) != 8 or any(
+            type(x) is not int or not 0 <= x <= 4095 for x in targets):
+        raise ValueError("eight PL target_raw values required")
+    return reply
+
+
+class HilBackend:
+    name = "hil"
+
+    def __init__(self, address):
+        host, port = address.rsplit(":", 1)
+        self.address = host, int(port)
+        self.plant = MujocoPlant()
+        self.socket = self.stream = None
+        self.reply = None
+        self.stopped = True
+        self.seq = 0
+        self._target = self.plant.feedback_raw()["position_raw"]
+        self._since_exchange = 0.0
+
+    def _roundtrip(self, frame):
+        if self.stream is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("HIL link is not open")
+        self.stream.write((json.dumps(frame, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode())
+        self.stream.flush()
+        line = self.stream.readline(4097)
+        if len(line) > 4096 or not line.endswith(b"\n"):
+            raise ValueError("HIL reply missing, oversized or incomplete")
+        return json.loads(line)
+
+    def open(self):
+        try:
+            self.socket = socket.create_connection(self.address, timeout=0.25)
+            self.stream = self.socket.makefile("rwb")
+            self.reply = validate_reply(self._roundtrip({"protocol": PROTOCOL, "cmd": "hello"}))
+            self.seq = self.reply["accepted_seq"]
+            # Always require explicit reset for a new operator session.
+            self.emergency_stop()
+        except BaseException:
+            self.close()
+            raise
+
+    def _exchange(self, cmd):
+        self.seq += 1
+        try:
+            self.reply = validate_reply(self._roundtrip({
+                "protocol": PROTOCOL, "seq": self.seq, "heartbeat": self.seq,
+                "cmd": cmd, "target_raw": self._target,
+                "feedback": self.plant.feedback_raw(),
+            }), self.seq)
+            self.stopped = self.reply["state"] == "PROTECT" or bool(self.reply["fault"])
+            self.plant.apply_raw_targets(self.reply["target_raw"], self.reply["torque_enabled"])
+            self._since_exchange = 0
+        except BaseException:
+            self.stopped = True
+            self.plant.disable()
+            raise
+
+    def _motion(self, cmd):
+        if self.stopped:
+            raise RuntimeError("PL STOP is latched; explicit reset required")
+        if cmd in ("open", "grasp") and self.reply["state"] != "IDLE":
+            raise RuntimeError("PL motion is active; release or reset before a new grasp/open")
+        self._exchange(cmd)
+
+    def open_hand(self):
+        self._target = [sp.rad_to_raw(0.0)] * 8
+        self._motion("open")
+
+    def start_grasp_fsm(self, plan):
+        import math
+
+        self._target = [sp.rad_to_raw(math.radians(x)) for x in plan.angles_deg]
+        self._motion("grasp")
+
+    def hold(self):
+        self._motion("hold")
+
+    def release(self):
+        self._motion("release")
+
+    def reset(self):
+        self._target = self.plant.feedback_raw()["position_raw"]
+        self._exchange("reset")
+        if self.stopped:
+            raise RuntimeError("PL refused reset; inspect fault/feedback")
+
+    def emergency_stop(self):
+        try:
+            if self.stream is not None:
+                self._exchange("stop")
+        finally:
+            self.stopped = True
+            self.plant.disable()
+
+    def tick(self, dt_s):
+        self._since_exchange += dt_s
+        if self._since_exchange >= 0.02:
+            self._exchange("tick")
+        self.plant.step(dt_s)
+
+    def close(self):
+        try:
+            self.emergency_stop()
+        except Exception:
+            logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("HIL stop unconfirmed; PL watchdog must protect")
+        finally:
+            try:
+                if self.stream:
+                    self.stream.close()
+            finally:
+                if self.socket:
+                    self.socket.close()
+                self.stream = self.socket = None
+                self.plant.disable()

+"""Existing protocol/FSM with MuJoCo dynamics and measured feedback (Issue #10)."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+from app.control.backend_sim import SimBackend
+from app.control.mujoco_plant import MujocoPlant
+from app.control.scs_sim import VirtualServoBus
+from app.control.servo_base import FsmState
+
+
+class MujocoServoBus(VirtualServoBus):
+    def __init__(self, plant):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.plant = plant
+        self._update_feedback()
+
+    def _update_feedback(self):
+        feedback = self.plant.feedback_raw()
+        for i, sid in enumerate(self.servo_ids):
+            state = self.state(sid)
+            state.position_raw = feedback["position_raw"][i]
+            state.load_raw = feedback["load_raw"][i]
+
+    def step(self, dt_s):
+        states = [self.state(sid) for sid in self.servo_ids]
+        self.plant.apply_raw_targets([s.goal_raw for s in states],
+                                     [s.torque_on for s in states],
+                                     [s.goal_speed_raw for s in states])
+        self.plant.step(dt_s)
+        self._update_feedback()
+
+
+class MujocoBackend(SimBackend):
+    name = "mujoco"
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__(middle_deg=(0.0,) * 8)
+        self.plant = MujocoPlant()
+        self.bus = MujocoServoBus(self.plant)
+        self.stopped = False
+        self._discard_old_targets()
+
+    def _discard_old_targets(self):
+        for sid in self.bus.servo_ids:
+            state = self.bus.state(sid)
+            state.goal_raw = state.position_raw
+        self._plan = None
+        self._closing_hold_raw = None
+
+    def _check_enabled(self):
+        if self.stopped:
+            raise RuntimeError("STOP is latched; explicit reset required")
+
+    def set_torque(self, on):
+        if on:
+            self._check_enabled()
+        super().set_torque(on)
+        if not on:
+            # A dropped virtual servo ignores protocol writes. The simulator's
+            # local stop still owns its actuator enable; do not re-enable it
+            # from a stale virtual torque bit on the next physics step.
+            for sid in self.bus.servo_ids:
+                self.bus.state(sid).torque_on = False
+            self.plant.disable()
+
+    def set_targets(self, angles_deg, speed_raw=0):
+        self._check_enabled()
+        if len(angles_deg) != 8 or any(not math.isfinite(x) for x in angles_deg):
+            raise ValueError("need eight finite target angles")
+        super().set_targets(angles_deg, speed_raw)
+
+    def start_grasp_fsm(self, plan):
+        self._check_enabled()
+        super().start_grasp_fsm(plan)
+
+    def open_hand(self):
+        self._check_enabled()
+        self._discard_old_targets()
+        self._enter(FsmState.IDLE)
+        self.set_torque(True)
+        self.set_targets((0.0,) * 8, speed_raw=3)
+
+    def hold(self):
+        self._check_enabled()
+        self._closing_hold_raw = tuple(f.position_raw for f in self._read_feedback())
+        self.set_targets(tuple(f.position_deg for f in self._read_feedback()))
+        self._enter(FsmState.HOLD)
+
+    def release(self):
+        self._check_enabled()
+        # Existing backend only accepts release from CLOSING/HOLD. A user may
+        # release during PREGRASP or manual opening too; cancel safely to zero.
+        if self._fsm in (FsmState.CLOSING, FsmState.HOLD) and self._plan is not None:
+            super().release()
+        else:
+            self.open_hand()
+
+    def emergency_stop(self):
+        self.stopped = True
+        super().emergency_stop()
+        self._discard_old_targets()
+
+    def reset(self):
+        # Remain unpowered until the next explicit motion; never replay targets.
+        self.plant.disable()
+        self._discard_old_targets()
+        self.stopped = False
+        self._closed_by_timeout = False
+        self._enter(FsmState.IDLE)
+
+    def tick(self, dt_s):
+        try:
+            # Catch faults before the inherited FSM can submit another target.
+            if any(s.dropped or s.error_bits for s in
+                   (self.bus.state(i) for i in self.bus.servo_ids)):
+                self.emergency_stop()
+            super().tick(dt_s)
+            if self._fsm == FsmState.PROTECT:
+                self.stopped = True
+        except BaseException:
+            self.emergency_stop()
+            raise
+
+    def close(self):
+        self.emergency_stop()

+"""Real MuJoCo plant shared by the local Host backend and the HIL adapter.
+
+Raw conversion follows the repository's SIM profile, not calibrated SCS0009.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+import mujoco
+import numpy as np
+
+from app.control import scs_protocol as sp
+
+
+class MujocoPlant:
+    def __init__(self):
+        sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "sim"))
+        from collision_model import build_collision_model
+
+        self.model = build_collision_model()
+        for geom in range(self.model.ngeom):
+            body = self.model.geom_bodyid[geom]
+            if self.model.body_mocapid[body] >= 0:
+                self.model.geom_rgba[geom, 3] = 0
+        self.data = mujoco.MjData(self.model)
+        names = [self.model.actuator(i).name for i in range(self.model.nu)]
+        expected = [f"finger{i}_motor{j}" for i in range(1, 5) for j in (1, 2)]
+        if names != expected:
+            raise ValueError(f"unexpected actuator mapping: {names}")
+        self.qadr = self.model.jnt_qposadr[self.model.actuator_trnid[:, 0]]
+        self.dadr = self.model.jnt_dofadr[self.model.actuator_trnid[:, 0]]
+        self._gain = self.model.actuator_gainprm.copy()
+        self._bias = self.model.actuator_biasprm.copy()
+        self._targets = np.zeros(8)
+        self._enabled = np.zeros(8, dtype=bool)
+        self._speed = np.full(8, math.radians(60.0))
+        self._remainder = 0.0
+        # Settle the parallel linkage at model zero, without changing upstream XML.
+        for _ in range(800):
+            mujoco.mj_step(self.model, self.data)
+        self.disable()
+
+    @property
+    def positions_rad(self):
+        return self.data.qpos[self.qadr].copy()
+
+    def apply_raw_targets(self, target_raw, torque_enabled, speed_raw=None):
+        if len(target_raw) != 8 or any(type(x) is not int or not 0 <= x <= 4095 for x in target_raw):
+            raise ValueError("target_raw must contain eight integers in 0..4095")
+        enabled = np.asarray(torque_enabled, dtype=bool)
+        if enabled.ndim == 0:
+            enabled = np.full(8, bool(enabled))
+        if enabled.shape != (8,):
+            raise ValueError("torque mask must contain eight channels")
+        targets = np.array([sp.raw_to_rad(x) for x in target_raw])
+        self._targets[:] = np.clip(targets, *self.model.actuator_ctrlrange.T)
+        self._enabled[:] = enabled
+        self.model.actuator_gainprm[:] = self._gain
+        self.model.actuator_biasprm[:] = self._bias
+        self.model.actuator_gainprm[~enabled] = 0
+        self.model.actuator_biasprm[~enabled] = 0
+        if speed_raw is not None:
+            # Deliberate simulation rate: raw 3 -> 60 deg/s; not a servo unit claim.
+            self._speed[:] = np.radians([min(180.0, x * 20.0) if x else 180.0
+                                         for x in speed_raw])
+        if not enabled.any():
+            self.disable()
+
+    def disable(self):
+        """Simulator safe stop: zero actuation and pause physics at measured pose."""
+        self._enabled[:] = False
+        self._targets[:] = self.positions_rad
+        self.data.ctrl[:] = self.positions_rad
+        self.data.qvel[:] = 0
+        self.model.actuator_gainprm[:] = 0
+        self.model.actuator_biasprm[:] = 0
+        mujoco.mj_forward(self.model, self.data)
+
+    def step(self, dt_s):
+        if not math.isfinite(dt_s) or not 0 <= dt_s <= 0.1:
+            self.disable()
+            raise ValueError("plant dt must be finite and in 0..0.1 s")
+        if not self._enabled.any():
+            return
+        self._remainder += dt_s
+        step = float(self.model.opt.timestep)
+        while self._remainder + 1e-12 >= step:
+            delta = np.clip(self._targets - self.data.ctrl, -self._speed * step, self._speed * step)
+            self.data.ctrl[self._enabled] += delta[self._enabled]
+            mujoco.mj_step(self.model, self.data)
+            self._remainder -= step
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(self.data.qpos)):
+            self.disable()
+            raise RuntimeError("non-finite MuJoCo state")
+
+    def feedback_raw(self):
+        return {
+            "position_raw": [sp.rad_to_raw(float(x)) for x in self.positions_rad],
+            "load_raw": [min(1023, int(abs(x) * 100)) for x in self.data.actuator_force],
+            "online_mask": 255,
+        }

+"""Issue #10: actual MuJoCo feedback, live changes, hold and latched stop."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import unittest
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "host"))
+from sim.host_demo import LiveController

+from app.control.servo_base import FsmState
+
+
+class LiveTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.backend = MujocoBackend()
+
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.backend.reset()
+        self.controller = LiveController(self.backend)
+        self.backend.open_hand()
+        for _ in range(250):
+            self.backend.tick(0.01)
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.backend.close()
+
+    def advance(self, seconds):
+        for _ in range(round(seconds / 0.01)):
+            self.controller.tick(0.01)
+
+    def test_live_grasp_hold_release_and_measured_feedback(self):
+        start = self.backend.plant.positions_rad
+        self.assertTrue(self.controller.command("grasp", "apple"))
+        self.advance(1.0)
+        closed = self.backend.plant.positions_rad
+        self.assertGreater(np.max(np.abs(closed - start)), math.radians(10))
+        state = self.controller.telemetry()
+        np.testing.assert_allclose(state["positions_deg"], np.degrees(closed))
+        self.assertTrue(self.controller.command("hold"))
+        self.advance(0.4)
+        held = self.backend.plant.positions_rad
+        self.advance(0.5)
+        self.assertLess(np.max(np.abs(self.backend.plant.positions_rad - held)), math.radians(1))
+        self.assertTrue(self.controller.command("release"))
+        self.advance(2.0)
+        self.assertLess(np.max(np.abs(self.backend.plant.positions_rad)), math.radians(1))
+        self.assertEqual(self.backend.poll_fsm().state, FsmState.IDLE)
+
+    def test_new_input_changes_targets_and_joint_motion_online(self):
+        self.controller.command("grasp", "banana")
+        self.advance(0.8)
+        first = self.controller.telemetry()
+        self.controller.command("grasp", "bottle")
+        self.advance(0.8)
+        second = self.controller.telemetry()
+        self.assertNotEqual(first["target_raw"], second["target_raw"])
+        self.assertFalse(np.allclose(first["positions_deg"], second["positions_deg"], atol=1))
+
+    def test_stop_zeroes_actuation_freezes_old_goal_until_explicit_reset(self):
+        self.controller.command("grasp", "banana")
+        self.advance(0.6)
+        self.controller.command("stop")
+        stopped = self.backend.plant.positions_rad
+        for action in ("open", "grasp", "hold", "release"):
+            self.assertFalse(self.controller.command(action))
+        self.advance(0.5)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.backend.plant.positions_rad, stopped)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.backend.plant.data.actuator_force, np.zeros(8))
+        self.assertEqual(self.backend.poll_fsm().state, FsmState.PROTECT)
+        self.assertTrue(self.controller.command("reset"))
+        self.advance(0.2)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.backend.plant.positions_rad, stopped)
+        self.controller.command("open")
+        self.advance(2.0)
+        self.assertLess(np.max(np.abs(self.backend.plant.positions_rad)), math.radians(1))
+
+    def test_invalid_physics_step_stops_before_propagating_error(self):
+        self.controller.command("grasp")
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
+            self.controller.tick(float("nan"))
+        self.assertTrue(self.backend.stopped)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.backend.plant.data.actuator_force, np.zeros(8))
+
+    def test_offline_feedback_stops_during_closing(self):
+        self.controller.command("grasp")
+        self.advance(0.5)
+        self.backend.bus.inject_drop([1])
+        try:
+            self.controller.tick(0.01)
+            self.assertTrue(self.backend.stopped)
+            self.assertEqual(self.backend.poll_fsm().state, FsmState.PROTECT)
+            stopped = self.backend.plant.positions_rad
+            self.advance(0.2)
+            np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.backend.plant.positions_rad, stopped)
+            np.testing.assert_array_equal(self.backend.plant.data.actuator_force, np.zeros(8))
+            self.assertFalse(any(self.backend.bus.state(i).torque_on for i in range(1, 9)))
+        finally:
+            self.backend.bus.inject_drop([1], False)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

+# Host → MuJoCo 实时控制（Issue #10）
+
+复用 `GraspSelector`、`SimBackend` 抓取状态机及协议总线，替换原来的线性模拟动力学，
+实际调用 `mujoco.mj_step`，从 `qpos` / `actuator_force` 返回反馈。输入来自当次按键、
+按钮或本地 API，没有自动播放序列。选择 banana/apple/bottle 使用仓库同名抓取策略；
+当前展示手部姿态控制，场景未放置可抓物体，不声称物体已被抓稳。
+
+## 启动
+
+从仓库根目录运行（Windows / Python 3.12）：
+
+```powershell
+git submodule update --init --depth 1 AmazingHand
+uv venv --python 3.12 .venv
+uv pip install --python .venv/Scripts/python.exe -r sim/requirements-live.txt
+.venv/Scripts/python.exe host/app/main.py --mujoco
+```
+
+`.gitmodules` 补齐已有模型子模块 URL；版本仍固定在原 gitlink `3e824107`，不改上游模型。
+没有 uv 时可用 `py -3.12 -m venv .venv` 和 `.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r sim/requirements-live.txt`。
+不需要安装整个板端 `requirements.txt`。
+
+按 **1/2/3** 选择香蕉/苹果/瓶子；**O** 张开、**G** 抓取、**H** 保持当前位置、
+**R** 释放、**S** 停止、**E** 显式复位，**Q/Esc** 或窗口 X 退出。鼠标按钮也可操作；
+拖动场景旋转，滚轮缩放。初始保持不动，只有输入命令才开始运动。
+
+面板显示控制状态、实测角度、实际执行器控制量和仿真负载。
+STOP 清除旧目标、禁用执行器并暂停物理状态，拒绝运动命令直到复位；复位不重放旧目标。
+主循环超期 500 ms 或物理步进异常会停止。关窗/正常结束会关闭后端，SIGINT/SIGTERM 请求退出。
+此处停机是模拟器语义，不代表物理机械手断力矩已验收。
+
+## 在线输入与验收
+
+窗口运行时，另一个 PowerShell 可发送指令、读取实际反馈：
+
+```powershell
+Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8767/command -Method Post -ContentType application/json -Body '{"action":"grasp","category":"apple"}'
+Invoke-RestMethod http://127.0.0.1:8767/state
+```
+
+API 仅绑定 loopback，返回 202 代表已入队；实际接受/拒绝结果见 `/state` 的 `events`。
+可用 `--headless` 运行相同真实物理/API而不显示窗口；`--duration 20 --snapshot tmp/panel.png`
+可限时退出并保存末帧（snapshot 仅 GUI）。后台 API 不应暴露给局域网。
+
+本机验证：5 项真实 MuJoCo 控制测试、原 backend 10 项和 sim 5 项通过；
+独立 GUI 进程通过 API 完成张开→抓取→保持→释放及停止/拒绝运动/复位，
+末轮实测关节变化约 48.2°、停止后位置不变且执行器输出为零，正常退出码 0。
+证据在本地 `tmp/mujoco-live-20261017/acceptance.json` 和 `live-panel.png`。
+GitHub交付归档见 [原始运行记录与本轮检查](../docs/evidence/2026-10-17/issue10/README.md)。
+
+```powershell
+.venv/Scripts/python.exe host/tests/test_mujoco_live.py
+.venv/Scripts/python.exe host/tests/test_hil_wire.py
+```
+
+角度按模型零位/弧度驱动，显示度；只在 SIM 适配中将预张开角改成模型零位，原抓取表不变。
+raw 沿用旧 golden profile（±π 映射 0..4095），负载 `abs(actuator_force)*100` 饱和至 1023，
+速度 raw3 在此演示为 60°/s。以上均非 SCS0009 实物标定或 v0.3 ABI。
+
+## 与 Issue #11 对接
+
+同一面板可使用独立 HIL 工程服务器：
+
+```powershell
+.venv/Scripts/python.exe host/app/main.py --mujoco --hil 192.28.14.153:8765
+```
+
+这需要 #11 分支的 `fpga/hand_control/ps/hil_server.py` 与配套 AHIL PL profile；
+不兼容现有相机 bit 或旧 Host FPGA 寄存器。没有板卡时会失败，不回退软件状态机。
+连接后先 E 复位，再 O/G 等操作。HIL 的新 open/grasp 只在 IDLE 接受，重复动作前先释放或复位。
+尚未声称已执行实板 HIL。
+
+`amazinghand-hil/1` 使用 TCP NDJSON，50 Hz；先 `hello` 读取 accepted_seq，然后发送严格递增的
+seq/heartbeat（相等）、cmd、八路 target_raw 和 feedback(position_raw/load_raw/online_mask)。
+只有来自 PL 的 target_raw/torque_enabled 驱动物理；MuJoCo 实测反馈回灌 PL。
+回复必须含 source=pl、匹配的 seq/accepted_seq/feedback_seq、state/fault/pl_tick 和
+command_count/feedback_count。客户端超时 250 ms、PL watchdog 500 ms，失败即暂停本机物理；
+需记录板端计数器/波形才可验收硬件闭环，wire 测试不代替这项证据。

+"""Interactive Host -> MuJoCo loop. Inputs arrive live, never from a timeline."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+from collections import deque
+from dataclasses import replace
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+import json
+import math
+from pathlib import Path
+import signal
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+
+import cv2
+import mujoco
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "host"))
+from app.control.backend_mujoco import MujocoBackend
+from app.strategy.grasp_selector import GraspSelector
+
+ACTIONS = ("open", "grasp", "hold", "release", "stop", "reset")
+
+
+class LiveController:
+    """Manual Host input uses the existing selector and backend grasp FSM."""
+    def __init__(self, backend=None):
+        self.backend = backend or MujocoBackend()
+        self.selector = GraspSelector()
+        self.category = "banana"
+        self.events = deque(maxlen=60)
+        self.message = "Ready. Select an object, then issue a command."
+        self._seq = 0
+
+    def command(self, action, category=None):
+        if action not in ACTIONS:
+            raise ValueError("unknown action")
+        if category is not None:
+            if category not in self.selector.known_objects:
+                raise ValueError("choose banana, apple or bottle")
+            self.category = category
+        self._seq += 1
+        try:
+            if action == "grasp":
+                plan = self.selector.select(self.category)
+                # Model zero is its open pose. Mechanical servo pregrasp offsets
+                # in the uncalibrated table must not be presented as model zero.
+                plan = replace(plan, pregrasp_deg=(0.0,) * 8)
+                self.backend.start_grasp_fsm(plan)
+            elif action == "open":
+                self.backend.open_hand()
+            else:
+                getattr(self.backend, action if action != "stop" else "emergency_stop")()
+            self.message = f"{action}: {self.category}"
+            accepted = True
+        except RuntimeError as exc:
+            self.message = str(exc)
+            accepted = False
+        self.events.append({"seq": self._seq, "action": action,
+                            "category": self.category, "accepted": accepted})
+        return accepted
+
+    def tick(self, dt_s):
+        self.backend.tick(dt_s)
+
+    def telemetry(self):
+        backend = self.backend
+        plant = backend.plant
+        snap = backend.poll_fsm()
+        return {
+            "source": "mujoco", "seq": self._seq, "state": snap.state.name,
+            "stopped": backend.stopped, "timeout": snap.timeout,
+            "fault": snap.fault, "err_bitmap": snap.err_bitmap,
+            "torque_enabled": any(backend.bus.state(i).torque_on for i in range(1, 9)),
+            "category": self.category, "sim_time_s": float(plant.data.time),
+            "positions_deg": np.degrees(plant.positions_rad).tolist(),
+            "ctrl_deg": np.degrees(plant.data.ctrl).tolist(),
+            "target_raw": [backend.bus.state(i).goal_raw for i in range(1, 9)],
+            "load_raw": [f.load_raw for f in snap.feedback],
+            "actuator_force": plant.data.actuator_force.tolist(),
+            "message": self.message, "events": list(self.events),
+        }
+
+
+class CommandMailbox:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.queue = deque()
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+        self.state = {"state": "STARTING"}
+
+    def submit(self, action, category=None):
+        if action not in ACTIONS or (category is not None and category not in ("banana", "apple", "bottle")):
+            raise ValueError("invalid action or category")
+        with self.lock:
+            if action == "stop":
+                self.queue.clear()
+                self.queue.appendleft((action, category))
+            elif len(self.queue) < 32:
+                self.queue.append((action, category))
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("command queue full")
+
+    def drain(self):
+        with self.lock:
+            commands = list(self.queue)
+            self.queue.clear()
+            return commands
+
+    def publish(self, state):
+        with self.lock:
+            self.state = state
+
+
+class HilController(LiveController):
+    def __init__(self, address):
+        from app.control.backend_hil import HilBackend
+
+        super().__init__(HilBackend(address))
+        self.message = "PL HIL: press E to reset before commanding motion"
+
+    def telemetry(self):
+        plant = self.backend.plant
+        reply = self.backend.reply or {}
+        return {
+            "source": "pl", "seq": self._seq, "state": reply.get("state", "PROTECT"),
+            "stopped": self.backend.stopped, "timeout": bool(reply.get("fault", 0) & 1),
+            "torque_enabled": reply.get("torque_enabled", False),
+            "category": self.category, "sim_time_s": float(plant.data.time),
+            "positions_deg": np.degrees(plant.positions_rad).tolist(),
+            "ctrl_deg": np.degrees(plant.data.ctrl).tolist(),
+            "target_raw": reply.get("target_raw", []),
+            "load_raw": plant.feedback_raw()["load_raw"],
+            "actuator_force": plant.data.actuator_force.tolist(),
+            "message": self.message, "events": list(self.events), "pl": reply,
+        }
+
+
+def serve_commands(mailbox, port):
+    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def log_message(self, *_args):
+            pass
+
+        def send_json(self, status, value):
+            body = json.dumps(value, allow_nan=False).encode()
+            self.send_response(status)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
+            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(body)
+
+        def do_GET(self):
+            if self.path != "/state":
+                self.send_json(404, {"error": "use GET /state or POST /command"})
+                return
+            with mailbox.lock:
+                state = mailbox.state
+            self.send_json(200, state)
+
+        def do_POST(self):
+            try:
+                if self.path != "/command" or self.headers.get("Content-Type") != "application/json":
+                    raise ValueError("POST /command with application/json required")
+                origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
+                if origin and origin not in (f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", f"http://localhost:{port}"):
+                    raise ValueError("foreign origin")
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
+                if not 0 < length <= 1024:
+                    raise ValueError("body must be 1..1024 bytes")
+                self.connection.settimeout(1.0)
+                value = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
+                mailbox.submit(value["action"], value.get("category"))
+                self.send_json(202, {"queued": True})
+            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, TimeoutError) as exc:
+                self.send_json(400, {"error": str(exc)})
+
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), Handler)
+    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
+    return server
+
+
+def draw_panel(renderer, camera, controller, state):
+    renderer.update_scene(controller.backend.plant.data, camera=camera)
+    frame = cv2.cvtColor(renderer.render(), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
+    image = np.full((860, 1280, 3), (27, 23, 18), dtype=np.uint8)
+    image[:520] = frame
+
+    def text(value, x, y, color=(228, 232, 237), scale=0.57):
+        cv2.putText(image, value, (x, y), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, scale, color, 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
+
+    text("AMAZINGHAND  /  " + ("PL HIL CONTROL" if state["source"] == "pl" else "LIVE HOST CONTROL"),
+         24, 34, scale=0.8)
+    if state["source"] == "pl":
+        pl = state["pl"]
+        text(f"PL tick {pl.get('pl_tick')}  |  accepted {pl.get('accepted_seq')}  |  "
+             f"feedback {pl.get('feedback_count')}  |  commands {pl.get('command_count')}  |  fault {pl.get('fault')}",
